OR-E6.Description:
Add the protected admin area and harden the application for production: authentication, audit logging, sync and referral status views, security headers, rate limits, end-to-end tests, and deployment readiness. Closes the MVP against its acceptance criteria.

SCOPE:
- Admin authentication and authorisation (ADR-003)
- audit_logs for meaningful admin actions
- Catalogue sync status and manual sync trigger
- Product visibility/featured selection (if required by owner)
- Referral configuration status (read-only) and basic click analytics
- Secure headers, narrow CORS verification, rate limits
- Playwright end-to-end tests for critical journeys and admin protection
- Deployment gates, production env template, deployment documentation
- Final MVP acceptance review

OUT OF SCOPE:
- Editable referral settings persisted in a database (unless explicitly requested)
- Multi-tenancy, vendor management, billing
- Checkout/payment integration

REFERENCE DOCS:
- docs/SECURITY.md
- docs/REFERRAL.md (Admin Visibility)
- docs/DEPLOYMENT-GATES.md
- infrastructure/AGENT.md, infrastructure/DEPLOYMENT.md
- docs/PLAN.md (MVP Acceptance Criteria)

SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- All admin endpoints and pages reject unauthenticated and unauthorised access
- Admin actions are audit-logged
- Referral configuration shown as status with explanation that changes are made via deployment environment settings
- Security headers present; CORS narrow; rate limits active on login, search, and handoff
- Playwright critical journey and admin-protection specs pass in CI
- Every item in docs/PLAN.md MVP Acceptance Criteria checked with evidence
- Backend and frontend gates pass; all deployment gates pass

Choose and implement admin authentication.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- docs/adr/ADR-003-admin-authentication.md: compare session cookie vs JWT vs external IdP for a single-owner admin; record decision
- If password-based: admin_users table (id, email unique, password_hash argon2/bcrypt, is_active, created_at, last_login_at) + migration (RLS enabled, no policies — Supabase Data API lockdown per docs/DATABASE.md); CLI command to create the first admin (no default credentials, no seeded passwords)
- POST /api/v1/admin/login, POST /api/v1/admin/logout; HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict session cookie; session expiry
- Frontend /admin/login page (Zod + React Hook Form); admin pages excluded from sitemap and set noindex

EFFORT: L (8 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend / Frontend / Security
DEPENDENCIES: OR-E1

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Valid login sets cookie; invalid credentials return generic error
- Passwords stored only as hashes; no credentials in logs or fixtures
- Session expires and logout invalidates it

EDGE CASES:
- Brute force: login rate limited per IP and per account with temporary lockout
- Inactive admin cannot log in
- No admin exists yet: admin area shows setup instruction (CLI), never an open registration page

OR-E6.Summary: Admin authorisation dependency and CSRF protection
OR-E6.Description:
Guarantee no admin route is publicly accessible.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- core/security.py: require_admin dependency applied at the admin router level (not per endpoint) so new endpoints inherit protection
- CSRF protection for state-changing admin requests (double-submit token or SameSite=Strict + Origin check, per ADR-003)
- Next.js middleware redirecting unauthenticated /admin/* requests to /admin/login; server-side check repeated in admin data fetching

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend / Frontend / Security
DEPENDENCIES: OR-044

TESTING CRITERIA:
- tests/security/test_admin_access.py: every route under /api/v1/admin returns 401/403 without a valid session (enumerated from the router so new routes are covered automatically)
- State-changing request without CSRF token/valid Origin rejected

EDGE CASES:
- Expired session mid-action: 401 and redirect to login, no partial action
- Admin API reached directly bypassing Next.js: still protected by backend dependency

Record meaningful admin actions.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- audit_logs table (id, occurred_at, admin_user_id, action, target_type, target_id, details JSON without secrets) + migration (RLS enabled, no policies — Supabase Data API lockdown per docs/DATABASE.md)
- services/audit.py: record(action, ...) called by admin services (login, logout, manual sync, visibility/featured changes)
- Admin page listing recent audit entries (paginated)

EFFORT: S (3 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend / Frontend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-045

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Each admin action produces exactly one audit row
- details never contain passwords, session tokens, or the consultant code

EDGE CASES:
- Audit write failure on a state-changing action: action rolled back (same transaction) rather than unaudited
- Failed login attempts logged without storing the attempted password

OR-E6.Summary: Catalogue sync status and manual sync trigger
OR-E6.Description:
Let the admin see sync health and start a sync.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- GET /api/v1/admin/sync-runs (paginated, newest first) and POST /api/v1/admin/sync (starts CatalogueSyncService in a background task; returns run id)
- Admin page: last successful sync age, latest runs with status and counts, error detail, 'Run sync now' button with confirmation
- Audit-logged

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend / Frontend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-046, OR-E2

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Manual trigger creates a run and reports completion status when polled
- Trigger while a run is in progress returns 409 with clear message

EDGE CASES:
- Fixture source selected in production: trigger refused
- Process restart during a run: stale run marked failed on next trigger (OR-014 recovery)

OR-E6.Summary: Product visibility and featured selection (if required)
OR-E6.Description:
Allow the owner to hide products or feature them on the homepage — only if the owner confirms it is required.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Confirm requirement with owner; if not required, close task as 'not needed' with note in todo.md
- PATCH /api/v1/admin/products/{slug} accepting is_visible and is_featured only
- Admin product table with search, toggles, and pagination
- Sync must not overwrite owner-set visibility/featured flags (document precedence)
- Audit-logged; affected pages revalidated

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend / Frontend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-046

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Toggle reflected on storefront after revalidation
- Subsequent sync preserves owner flags
- Request with other fields (price, name) rejected (422)

EDGE CASES:
- Admin cannot edit product facts (name, price, availability) — sourced data stays authoritative
- Featuring a hidden product: rejected or auto-unfeatured with message

OR-E6.Summary: Referral configuration status and click analytics
OR-E6.Description:
Show referral setup health and basic click analytics without a misleading edit form.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- GET /api/v1/admin/referral-status: ReferralService.status() (method, configured/not_configured/invalid, referral host) — never returns the full code (masked, e.g. last 2 characters) unless ADR-002 marks it public
- GET /api/v1/admin/referral-clicks?from=&to=: daily counts by method and origin
- Admin page: status card with text 'Referral settings are managed through deployment environment settings' and link to infrastructure/DEPLOYMENT.md guidance; simple daily chart/table
- No editable referral form

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend / Frontend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-045, OR-E4

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Status correct for configured, missing, and invalid-host settings
- Code masked in response; analytics totals match stored clicks

EDGE CASES:
- Date range too large: bounded (e.g. 366 days)
- Analytics labelled 'handoff clicks' — never 'sales' or 'conversions'

OR-E6.Summary: Security headers, CORS verification, and rate limits
OR-E6.Description:
Harden HTTP behaviour across frontend and backend.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Next.js headers(): Content-Security-Policy (self + authorised image hosts; no unsafe-inline scripts beyond JSON-LD handled via nonce or hashed), Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy, frame-ancestors 'none'
- Backend security headers middleware for API responses
- Rate limiting (in-process limiter acceptable for single instance; document Redis upgrade path only if multi-instance) on login, search, handoff, contact form
- Verify CORS_ORIGINS in production contains only the site origin

EFFORT: M (5 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend / Frontend / Security
DEPENDENCIES: OR-044

TESTING CRITERIA:
- tests/security/test_headers_cors.py: headers present; disallowed origin gets no CORS headers
- Rate limit returns 429 after threshold with Retry-After
- CSP does not break pages (Playwright smoke passes with CSP enabled)

EDGE CASES:
- Proxy/CDN in front: client IP derived only from trusted proxy headers (configurable), not spoofable X-Forwarded-For
- Do not add Redis unless multi-instance deployment requires it (ask first)

OR-E6.Summary: Playwright end-to-end tests for critical journeys
OR-E6.Description:
Prove the main customer journeys and admin protection work end to end.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- e2e/browse-to-handoff.spec.ts: homepage -> category -> product detail -> add to list -> list -> 'Buy from Oriflame' (official_url mode asserts navigation target host; manual_code mode asserts instructions and copy action)
- e2e/search.spec.ts: search returns results and handles no results
- e2e/admin-protection.spec.ts: /admin redirects to login; login works with test admin created by CLI in setup; logout
- e2e/accessibility.spec.ts: axe checks on key templates (if @axe-core/playwright is approved as a dependency)
- Run against development fixtures and test referral config; CI job enabled

EFFORT: M (6 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Testing
DEPENDENCIES: OR-047, OR-049, OR-050

TESTING CRITERIA:
- All specs pass locally and in CI; traces kept on failure

EDGE CASES:
- Tests never navigate to the real Oriflame site (intercept outbound navigation and assert URL)
- Test admin credentials generated per run, never committed

OR-E6.Summary: Deployment readiness: gates, production env template, deployment docs
OR-E6.Description:
Make the application deployable with documented, verifiable steps.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- docs/adr/ADR-004-deployment-target.md: chosen hosting for Next.js and FastAPI (database is a separate production Supabase project) (ask before any paid service)
- .env.production.example documenting every production variable with empty values
- Implement automated checks for docs/DEPLOYMENT-GATES.md gates in CI (migrations on fresh DB, audits, fixture block, admin protection, SEO artefacts)
- infrastructure/DEPLOYMENT.md: exact deploy, migrate, rollback, and referral-config update steps for the chosen target
- Health/readiness endpoints wired to the platform's health checks

EFFORT: M (6 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Infrastructure / Docs
DEPENDENCIES: OR-051

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Fresh deployment to a non-production environment following the docs succeeds (evidence in todo.md Review)
- Rollback procedure exercised once

EDGE CASES:
- Missing production variable: deploy fails at startup validation, not at first request
- Migration failure: deployment halts before switching traffic

Verify every MVP acceptance criterion with evidence before declaring the MVP complete.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Walk through docs/PLAN.md MVP Acceptance Criteria; for each, attach evidence (command output, test name, screenshot, or link) in docs/tasks/todo.md Review
- Confirm: no committed secrets (git history scan), no NEXT_PUBLIC consultant code, no fabricated data, no attribution or live-availability claims, independence disclaimer present
- Confirm multi-tenant readiness: configuration flows through ConfigProvider; no tenant assumptions hardcoded in catalogue or referral services
- Update README status, AGENT.md MVP overview, docs/PLAN.md statuses, docs/tasks/lessons.md, and checkpoint

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: QA / Docs
DEPENDENCIES: OR-044 through OR-052

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Every acceptance criterion checked with linked evidence; any unmet criterion has an open task
- Backend and frontend gates and all deployment gates pass on the final commit

EDGE CASES:
- A criterion cannot be verified (e.g. owner has not confirmed referral mechanism): MVP marked complete-with-exceptions, exception listed explicitly — never claimed as passed
